office_does: A State Representative writes and votes on Washington state law and the operating, capital and transportation budgets.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Hunter Abell (Prefers Republican Party) is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: First-term 7th District state representative, an attorney, rancher, Navy commander and past state bar president; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: State representative since 2025; past Washington State Bar Association president and former Ferry County District Court judge [S1]
Priorities: constitutional rights, the rural way of life, and a more prosperous state for families and businesses [S1]
Voted Nay on ESSB 6346, the 2026 tax on income over $1 million [S2]
